summary.headline: Astrological Judgment of War
summary.text: Astrological judgment of a conflict between an opposing enemy and his adversaries: Mercury, Saturn, Venus, Mars, the Moon, and Jupiter signify repeated battle, weakness, victory, subjection, and the peaceful acquisition of a kingdom through sextile and reception.
